quotes.quote: From the dress styles I’d submitted when booking, Vicky had already picked out the exact dresses I’d been looking at on the website! Her knowledge and passion for helping brides find the dress were second to none. The whole experience felt so personal, relaxed and memorable.

I actually ended up choosing a dress that I hadn’t considered at all when I first went in, but Sam picked it for me and it was absolutely perfect! It just goes to show how well they understood what I was looking for, even when I didn’t know myself. I never felt pressured at any point.

Vicky & Sam phoned before the appointment to get ideas of what styles I wanted. They had so many small touches that made it special like adding my name to the mirror and even setting the lighting to see what the dresses look like in the evening! An evening we will never forget.

I booked to try on wedding dresses for the first time without family because I hadn't planned on buying, but Vicky and her daughter made me feel like I was the only girl in the world during my appointment. They made me feel so welcome and comfortable.

From the moment we arrived, they made us feel so welcome and even offered us a glass of prosecco. They took the time to understand my budget and guided me through without any pressure. If a dress was over my budget, they let me know beforehand, which I really appreciated.
